channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Red tape is strangling rural health care. Let’s cut it
item.description: Rural communities face severe doctor shortages, worsened by state rules limiting nurse practitioners, physician assistants and new clinics. The piece argues cutting these barriers and boosting rural training could expand care.

item.title: Our Opinion: NC’s high court seeks solutions to legal deserts
item.description: Facing “legal deserts” in nearly half of North Carolina counties, the state Supreme Court has created a commission to study new ways to license and deploy non-lawyer legal help.

item.title: For Your Health: Hospital helps you care for your heart
item.description: Wilson Medical Center marks Heart Month with free community events, expert cardiology advice and fitness activities to support heart health throughout Wilson County.

item.title: Council split over broadcasting public comment
item.description: Wilson City Council will televise the public comment section of its regular monthly meetings for the first time in a decade following an intense exchange of words and a split 4-3 council vote.

item.title: Area Calendar, Feb. 6-7, 2026
item.description: Weekend area sports schedule: Barton teams in action across volleyball, basketball, baseball, softball, bowling, lacrosse and tennis, plus full slate of local high school basketball and JV games Feb. 6-7.

item.title: Barton’s furious late rally falls short in 79-76 loss at Southern Wesleyan
item.description: Barton claws back from 16 down but falls 79-76 at Southern Wesleyan, its third straight loss, despite 18-point nights from Jaylen Faber and Sean Quick-Streeter.

item.title: Bulldogs ride Sleight’s 21 points, big rebounding edge to 76-71 win at SWU
item.description: Layne Sleight scored 21 points and Barton dominated the boards in a 76-71 road win at Southern Wesleyan, overcoming Makayla Raines’ 37-point outburst in Conference Carolinas play.

item.title: Edwards’ career-high highlights Senior Night romp at Greenfield
item.description: Kobe Edwards scored a career-high 41 points on Senior Night as No. 1 Greenfield routed Rocky Mount Academy 85-50, staying unbeaten in conference play ahead of rival Wayne Country Day and the CPIC tournament.

item.title: Hornets come out on top of Coby White trade
item.description: The Hornets landed Coby White and Mike Conley Jr. from the Bulls for Collin Sexton, Ousmane Dieng and three second-round picks, adding a younger scoring guard behind LaMelo Ball to bolster Charlotte’s developing core.
